scope: CPU-only source/log review and mock controller tests. No model endpoint, game action, reload or restart.

observedIncident.terrain: West neighbor feet/head oak_log; north/south/east feet leaf_litter and head air.

confirmedSourceBug: Every issued route reset candidateCursor=0, including a deferred reusedStalledEdge route. Each fallback examines at most four candidates. Thus repeated stationary stalls can continually recheck the same top four and never inspect later candidates. The stalled-edge memory was functioning; resetting the rotating search cursor defeated its ability to discover alternative destinations outside the first batch.
patch: Only fresh non-stalled-prefix routes reset the cursor. Deferred reused-stalled routes preserve the advanced cursor, permitting the next bounded attempt to inspect later candidates. Added candidatesExamined/candidateCount/nextCandidateCursor diagnostics.
unchangedConstraints: Fallback total CPU target60ms, existing per-search slice/time limits and at most4 candidates per attempt remain unchanged; overruns remain measured rather than a hard guarantee.
No digging logs, no relaxed dry/support/hazard/threat clearance checks, no towers or bridging.
Stalled route remains a temporary fallback if no checked alternative or permitted leaf exit exists; no permanent exclusion of the sole available route.
Existing edge expiry, leaf native lock/cancellation, close counterattack and model/executor division remain unchanged.
installedPathfinderFinding: movements.getMoveDiagonal checks the lower-cost of two orthogonal side corridors; a diagonal can be returned with a blocked block on the other side. The incident's oak_log and offset position are compatible with a corner-movement problem, but logged data do not establish exact physics or prove it caused the stall. No speculative collision-rule patch was made.
tests: minecraft-reactive-escape.js PASS: new fixture has more than four destinations; first four share stalled prefix, fifth has distinct prefix; after provisional reuse cursor stays4 and fifth is subsequently inspected/selected.
Existing unique same-prefix fallback, expiry, genuine waypoint progress, knockback non-progress, safe leaf alternative, noPath rotation and CPU measurement tests remain passing.
limits: Old logs did not capture candidate counts or search cursor, so actual availability of a safe later candidate in this encounter is unknown.
This fixes a demonstrated starvation path in code; it does not prove the observed death would have been prevented.
